description: Erase one memory by its cell id. Whether erasure is cryptographic (the key is destroyed, so no one can read the content again) or access-control (the cell is withdrawn from service) depends on the operator; check its documentation. Irreversible: use it when erasure is the intent, not to tidy a working set.

id.description: Memory entry ID (hex cellId) to erase

name: saihm_forget
title: Forget (GDPR erasure)
